name: 神保町 可以
address_ja: 東京都千代田区神田神保町2-2-12 サンエスビル 1F
cuisine: The second shop of Takadanobaba's 渡なべ, and one of the few places in central Tokyo doing 燕三条 back-fat niboshi ramen properly: a scalding lard-capped broth, small beads of back fat, a bitter, late-arriving sardine hit, wide flat extra-thick noodles and raw chopped onion, with 肩ロース chāshū. Twelve L-shaped counter seats, ticket machine, under ¥1,000; the shop's older 2色つけめん is still served alongside, and Niigata regional bowls like 長岡生姜醤油 appear as limiteds.
neighborhood: Kanda-Jimbōchō 2-chōme — 81 m and 2 minutes from Jimbōchō station exit A4 (Toei Mita, Toei Shinjuku and Tokyo Metro Hanzōmon lines): out of A4, left along Hakusan-dōri, then immediately left, and it is on the left, set a little back from the street behind a glass frontage.
hours_raw: 11:00 - 20:00　※X(旧Twitter)にて臨時休業のお知らせあり
gf_detail: No. The entire menu is wheat ramen and tsukemen — the house bowl uses a wide, flat, extra-thick wheat noodle — and a 燕三条 back-fat niboshi broth is finished with a shōyu kaeshi, i.e. wheat soy sauce; the limited 長岡生姜醤油 is another shōyu bowl. No allergen information is published on the shop's page or the group site, no tamari is mentioned, and twelve seats with one boiler leave no separable line.
vegan_detail: No. The defining broth is niboshi — dried sardine — under a layer of pork back fat and lard, and the standard bowl carries two slices of 肩ロース chāshū and, in its most-ordered form, a marinated soft-boiled egg. Nothing plant-based is offered.

roles: 有限会社渡なべスタイル 代表 (representative, Watanabe Style Ltd.)
ラーメンコンサルタント (ramen consultant and producer)
chef_bio.origin: Born in Tokyo in 1975; spent ages six to ten in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on his parents' posting
chef_bio.background: 可以 is the second shop of 渡なべ, the Takadanobaba ramen-ya that made 渡辺樹庵's name, and it opened on 2 March 2010 in the premises vacated by めん鳥. Watanabe is an unusual figure in Tokyo ramen: not a chef who came up through a kitchen, but a self-taught obsessive turned consultant. Born in Tokyo in 1975 and a graduate of Meiji Gakuin's economics faculty, he was hit at sixteen by a bowl at Shibuya's げんこつ屋 found through a Tokyo Walker feature — 「こんなに美味しいラーメンがあるのか！」 — started eating his way around the city, and by seventeen was making ramen at home, taking his cues from 永福町大勝軒. By his early twenties he had eaten at more than 2,000 shops nationwide (he now puts the running total past 10,000 bowls). While still a student he fell in with 松田澄夫 of 旭川ラーメン 松楽 and was asked to produce the shop; he renovated it as 麺や 楽 in Isehara in July 2001, produced ラーメン 横綱 in Koshigaya in April 2002, and opened his own 渡なべ in Takadanobaba the same month. The group now runs 渡なべ, 神保町 可以, 六坊担担面 in Ikebukuro and 札幌 六坊, opened in Takadanobaba in April 2025, alongside a long list of produced shops and a 独立開業 programme with named alumni. 可以 originally led on a 2色つけめん; it has since rebuilt itself around 新潟燕三条系背脂煮干し, with the two-colour tsukemen kept on in parallel — a reviewer's judgement on the switch is that 「渡辺樹庵氏プロデュースのご当地ラーメンは、かなり現地っぽさを上手く引き出してイイ感じの着地点に纏めてくる」, that his regional bowls get genuinely close to the originals. The room is a twelve-seat L-shaped counter, dark and calm in the group's house style, behind a glass front at the back of a small setback; ordering is by ticket machine to the right of the door and it is cash only. Tabelog rates it 3.71.
chef_bio.specialty: 背脂煮干しラーメン in the 燕三条 style — reviewers order it 味玉 (a marinated egg version was ¥850 at the time of the review cited, against a sub-¥1,000 band on Tabelog today). The older 2色つけめん is still available, and Niigata regional bowls such as 長岡生姜醤油ラーメン run as limiteds.

anecdotes.text: A reviewer's description of the bowl is the clearest published account of what the shop is now doing: a very hot broth under back fat and lard, with the sardine arriving late — 「煮干しの香りが後発的にジワジワ押し寄せて来る感じで、煮干感は結構強めでビター感を伴うちょっとワイルドな味わい」 — over 緩く縮れた平打ち極太麺, with two slices of 肩ロース chāshū, crunchy menma and coarsely chopped raw onion.
The same reviewer went specifically because the group keeps trading over New Year — 「『渡なべ』系列は正月でも結構営業してたよな！」 — which is how a lot of Tokyo ramen fans first find 可以.

Watanabe's own timeline dates his conversion precisely: aged sixteen, in his first year of high school, he read a Tokyo Walker ramen feature, went to げんこつ屋 in Shibuya, and started eating his way round the country.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13105204 lists 神保町 可以（じんぼうちょう かい）under 神保町/ラーメン・つけ麺 at 東京都千代田区神田神保町2-2-12 サンエスビル1F, tel 03-5215-5623, coordinates 35.69637/139.75741, 81 m and 2 minutes from Jimbōchō exit A4, 11:00–20:00 with unscheduled closures announced on X, 12 L-shaped counter seats, 予約不可, cash only, all non-smoking, an opening date of 2010年3月2日, a sub-¥1,000 band, a 3.71 rating, homepage watanabestyle.com, official account x.com/jimbocho_kai, and the note 「2号店 旗艦店：『渡なべ』＠高田馬場 オーナー：渡辺樹庵氏、『めん鳥』閉店跡地」. The group site watanabestyle.com carries a dedicated page for 可以 confirming the address, phone, X account and 2 March 2010 opening, and a full profile of 渡辺樹庵 (born Tokyo 1975, Kuala Lumpur 1981–85, Seikei High School, Meiji Gakuin economics, ramen consultant, representative of 有限会社渡なべスタイル, 10,000+ bowls, operator of 渡なべ / 神保町 可以 / 六坊担担面 / 札幌 六坊) with a dated career log from the 1991 げんこつ屋 visit through 麺や 楽 (July 2001), ラーメン 横綱 (April 2002) and 渡なべ (April 2002). A long Tabelog review (B219741695) documents the shop's shift from 2色つけめん to 新潟燕三条系背脂煮干し, the 味玉背脂煮干しラーメン at ¥850, the noodle and topping specification, the ticket machine and the A4-exit walking route, and notes a 長岡生姜醤油ラーメン limited.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Twelve seats, one noodle boiler, and a menu made entirely of wheat ramen and tsukemen. No allergen information is published by the shop or the group and nothing wheat-free is claimed.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The bowl is a shōyu-kaeshi 背脂煮干し — a reviewer notes 「かえしもキレはあるものの思いの外大人しめ」 — and the limited runs include a 長岡生姜醤油. Ordinary wheat soy sauce throughout; no tamari mentioned.

vegan_cross_contact.text: The broth is dried sardine under pork back fat and lard, and the bowl comes with 肩ロース chāshū and, usually, a marinated egg.

cultural_comfort.level: Easy — two minutes from the station, ticket machine, quiet room
cultural_comfort.note: Out of Jimbōchō exit A4, left onto Hakusan-dōri, then straight away left; the shop is on the left, tucked back a little from the street but glass-fronted and easy to see into. Buy a ticket from the machine on the right as you enter. Cash only, no reservations, twelve counter seats — but this is a calm, dark, well-kept room rather than a queue-and-shout ramen bar, and it is comfortable to sit alone in. Hours are a straightforward 11:00–20:00 with no fixed closing day, which is unusually convenient, but unscheduled closures are announced only on X (@jimbocho_kai), so check that before a special trip. The house bowl is genuinely spicy-adjacent rather than spicy — the heat comes from the ichimi on the table if you want it — but it is heavy: extra-thick noodles under lard, so plan the rest of the day accordingly. No English menu.

enrich_note: Confirmed exactly as recorded, including the sweep's oddly specific 「新潟背脂煮干しラーメン」. A nationwide Tabelog keyword search for 可以 (HTTP 200) returns 神保町 可以 as its first hit, 13105204, at 東京都千代田区神田神保町2-2-12 — matching the light record's 千代田区神田神保町・神保町駅 — with the rest of the hits being 可以登楼 hotels in Shiga and unrelated restaurants. The identification is then confirmed from the operator's own side: watanabestyle.com, the site of 渡なべスタイル, carries a page for 神保町 可以 giving the same address, the same telephone number and the same X account, and dating the opening to 2 March 2010. The Niigata claim in the light record checks out too — a long Tabelog review documents the shop's move from its original 2色つけめん to a 新潟燕三条系背脂煮干し as its main bowl. Coordinates updated to Tabelog's (35.696372, 139.757411), about 130 m from the sweep's approximate pin. The website field points at the group's page for this shop rather than at watanabestyle.com's front page, since the shop has no site of its own; menu_url is left null because no menu is published online. Note the ¥850 price quoted in chef_bio is the reviewer's, from an earlier visit — Tabelog's current band is ～￥999, so treat it as indicative rather than current.
